result.title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
result.summary: Test-time training (TTT) enables a deployed language model to internalize incoming context on-the-fly into a small set of fast-weight parameters, rather than merely treating it as transient context for attention. In-Place TTT recently made this idea practical for large language models by repurposing the down-projection of standard MLP blocks as fast weights. However, we find that its benefit largely disappears on realistic web long-context question answering. We attribute this to In-Place TTT's uniform write schedule: every chunk is written with equal strength, so irrelevant content dilutes query-relevant information in fast-weight memory. Building on this insight, we propose Select-TTT, a model-agnostic, query-conditioned rule for In-Place TTT that scales each chunk's write strength by its relevance to the user query. This relevance signal requires no supervision and no new parameters: it is read directly from the model's frozen output head, as the probability mass that a chunk's hidden states assign to the query tokens. A temperature-scaled softmax turns these scores into learning-rate multipliers, leaving the chunk-wise, context-parallel computation of In-Place TTT intact. Select-TTT consistently improves long-context question answering on two benchmarks and two backbones. These findings highlight the value of query-conditioned fast weight writes for practical test-time training on long-context question answering, which is also potentially promising for long-horizon agent tasks involving multiple user queries over evolving contexts.

AI.brief_summary: 论文发现 In-Place TTT 在真实长上下文问答中收益消失，归因于等强度写入使无关内容稀释记忆，遂提出 Select-TTT：用冻结输出头读出的 query token 概率作为无监督相关性信号，经温度 softmax 调节各 chunk 的 fast weight 写入强度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按 query 相关性决定写入强度、抑制无关内容稀释」的可核查线索，可能对应 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与 latent 状态信息坍缩问题；但实验仅在纯文本长上下文 QA 上，迁移到多模态 latent 状态尚属推测。
